title: Road to bigger abs update
summary: Short abs update during NH's recomp: core fat is dropping first, obliques and lower abs are now visible thanks to lots of leg raises, while legs remain fatty. He plans a possible fall competition and keeps recomping at the same bodyweight.
claims: When I lose fat it comes off my core first; my legs stay fatty longer
Obliques are now more defined and separated from the six-pack while my waist remains wide
Lots of leg raises are doing wonders for lower ab development and separation
I long thought I only had a four-pack; lower abs are catching up though the middle ones dominate
A good-looking core ties the whole physique together on stage
Recomp method: keep bodyweight stable, get stronger and let muscle consume the calories while fat goes away
stats: six-pack with visible lower abs and obliques
